clinvar_records.VCV8162: Pathogenic / no assertion criteria (0 star, 2004 legacy)

interpretation: AF ~5e-5 is not absent from population controls; higher than expected for a fully penetrant rare dominant DCM allele (usually absent/<1e-5), below BA1/BS1 benign cutoff. Consistent with reduced penetrance, risk-modifier, or benign misassignment. Undercuts a high-penetrance Mendelian interpretation of the CMD1O founder allele.
